items.title: What Is Qualcomm (QCOM) Worth Watching In Automotive AI Right Now?
items.summary: Qualcomm (NasdaqGS:QCOM) is deepening its role in autonomous driving as carmakers push new AI-powered driver-assistance features into upcoming models. Automakers are signaling a greater willingness to pay premiums for higher performance automotive processors that can run more advanced AI workloads in vehicles.
